meta.title: Screenshot button
meta.description: Adds a camera button next to the composer's send action. It captures one chosen monitor, every screen at once, or any rectangle you drag across several screens, and attaches the image to the draft, so a screenshot can be sent without a second app. The chosen screen — or the last rectangle — is remembered, so the usual case stays one click. Nothing is written to disk and the image only leaves the machine if the message is sent.

title: Capture a screen and attach it
change: right-click or the arrow to change
